The speaker describes the process of preparing the fish for frying, emphasizing the sensory details of the meal (smell, taste) and the joy of sharing it with others. regional_terms.feijão tropeiro: a traditional dish from the southern regions of Brazil, made with beans, pork, and cassava flour.
